refinement_notes.prd_review_gap_assessment: GAP-DIFF-001 (HIGH, FR-BULK numbering mismatch between PRD.md and PRD_DELTA) is internal to the PRD layer. The gap therefore does NOT propagate into the architecture; no corrective edit to the TDD is warranted.
